source_documents.title: NCPOR Official Sagar Kanya Fleet Page
source_documents.publisher: National Centre for Polar and Ocean Research, Goa

source_documents.title: NCPOR 2026 Sagar Kanya Operation & Maintenance Tender Specification

classification_definitions.PUBLISHED: Directly documented in authoritative NCPOR publications or tenders
classification_definitions.DERIVED: Mathematically calculated from published parameters without external speculation
classification_definitions.ASSUMED: Engineering approximations where authoritative vessel telemetry is not publicly released
classification_definitions.USER_CONFIGURED: Operational threshold intentionally adjustable by the voyage planner
classification_definitions.UNKNOWN: Explicitly documented as unavailable / uncertified in official NCPOR literature

length_overall_m.notes: Length overall (LOA) documented on main fleet specification

length_bp_m.notes: Length between perpendiculars (LBP) from 2026 tender specification

breadth_extreme_m.notes: Extreme breadth on main fleet specification

maximum_draft_m.notes: Consistently documented across all NCPOR publications

gross_tonnage.discrepancy_note: NCPOR website lists 4209 GRT (pre-modification); 2026 tender specifies 4888 GT. Tender value retained as authoritative modern specification.

deadweight_tonnes.notes: Maximum deadweight at summer load line

displacement_tonnes.source: Naval Architecture Estimation (Block coefficient Cb ~ 0.51 at draft 5.6m)
displacement_tonnes.notes: Estimated from LBP, breadth moulded, draft, and standard research vessel block coefficient

engine_output_kw.breakdown: 2 x 1230 kW main propulsion electric motors / generators

cruise_speed_knots.source: NCPOR published range is 8-10 knots; 9.0 knots selected as nominal mission reference point

min_operating_speed_knots.source: Operational engineering minimum for steerage way in Southern Ocean swells
min_operating_speed_knots.notes: Below 4 knots steerage and heading control degrade without bow thruster assistance

max_operating_speed_knots.source: Historical trials data for Sagar Kanya hull form (published cruising 10 kn max)
max_operating_speed_knots.notes: Full ahead sprint speed under calm conditions

fuel_capacity_m3.notes: Total usable Marine Gas Oil (MGO) bunker capacity

fuel_capacity_metric_tonnes.source: MGO density 0.850 t/m3 at 15 deg C

fuel_model.model_status: POC estimate (reduced-order cubic propulsion model + auxiliary hotel load)

nominal_propulsion_rate_mt_per_hour.notes: Calibrated to ~6.72 MT/day propulsion at 9.0 knots cruising

hotel_auxiliary_rate_mt_per_hour.notes: Calibrated to ~1.44 MT/day scientific labs, HVAC, navigation generators

total_calibrated_daily_burn_rate_mt.notes: (0.28 + 0.06) * 24 = 8.16 MT/day; 8.16 MT/day * 45 days = 367.2 MT (~99.8% of 368 MT bunker capacity)

ice_capability.source: NCPOR official records contain no certified Polar Class (PC) or Finnish-Swedish Ice Class rating for ORV Sagar Kanya
ice_capability.notes: ORV Sagar Kanya was designed primarily for tropical and sub-tropical Indian Ocean research. While she has operated in Southern Ocean sub-Antarctic waters during Indian Scientific Expeditions, she is NOT an icebreaker or heavy ice-class vessel.

max_operational_sic.notes: Conservative maximum sea ice concentration (15%) for open water transit; avoid compact pack ice

preferred_max_sic.notes: Optimal route threshold (open water / very open pack < 5%)

max_safe_wave_height_m.notes: Significant wave height Hs threshold beyond which course alteration or speed reduction is mandatory

preferred_max_wave_height_m.notes: Comfortable scientific research operational sea state threshold

max_operational_wind_speed_ms.notes: Approximately 39 knots (Gale Force 8); triggers severe aerodynamic resistance penalty

safety_under_keel_clearance_m.notes: Required depth clearance below 5.6m keel (safe depth threshold = 8.6m)

under_keel_rule.notes: Rule applied when bathymetry depth minus draft is less than required clearance

discrepancies.resolution: Retained 4888 GT from the latest 2026 tender as the modern post-refit registered value, while logging the historical 4209 GRT value.
Both preserved: 16.39 m extreme breadth vs 16.30 m moulded breadth.
Both preserved: 100.34 m LOA vs 89.00 m LBP.
